title: Recognizing medical emergencies
supports: plain-language emergency signs including uncontrolled bleeding, breathing problems, mental-status change, chest pain, fainting, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting/diarrhea, sudden dizziness/weakness/vision change, seizures, and facial/tongue swelling
source_limit: Emergency signs are not exhaustive and local emergency procedures vary.
